0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak) host the Miami Heat (3-6, coming off a loss) with Utah 14th in the West and Miami 9th in the East. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Jazz won the last meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026, while the 2026-27 series has no games yet.
